clue.text: Greeting sons in urgent whisper

parts.note: taken as written

taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Lancelot Brown was nicknamed Capability, so the nickname stands for the gardener himself.

clue.text: Criminal keen to pull automatic

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Cleopatra's maid goes back for dress

clue.text: Fills out float, freezing

clue.text: Coward's celebration?

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: To effloresce is to burst into flower, a formal verb for blooming.
